translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: JUAN
book.title: Dos Moppiyon Dinoggan no id Sulat ni JUAN

content: Id Bowiyan ni Disas iddos Minuvun Butud
Laggun tid ipanow onsi Disas, nokita rin iddos minuvun butud pomon poron to kodtobbow rin.
Na mid intud ki Disas iddos mgo tinodduwan din, kahi ran to, “Tohodnonaw, ondoy man kos nokosaa no id tobbow sikandin no butud? Sikandin bo o iddos amoy woy inoy rin?”
Mid tavak si Disas to, “Id tobbow sikandin no butud, konna pomon to kandin no saa o pomon to saa to amoy woy inoy rin, ko konna, amoy od kokita iddos kotuusan to Monama riyot kandin no umuu.
Laggun to allow pa, ko‑ilangan nod puungan ta iddos id sanna taddot id popiyod koddi, su otid kovulli ron, worad od pokopuung.
Oyyos laggun to ka‑ay a pa, siyak kos ko‑owangan nod taddow to mgo minuvu ka‑ay to ampow't ingod.”
Nopongnga rin osenga idda, id ilob sikandin diyot livuta woy id bovallan din idda no basak woy id daddas din diyot mata taddot butud.
Kahi rin to, “Undiyon ka to Linow't Siloe woy pondappug ka rutun.” (Dos kohulugan to Siloe, id popiyod.) De‑en mid undiyon iddos butud woy id pondappug, woy id uli sikandin nod pokokita ron.
Na, iddos mgo sumbaoy rin woy dos dumon nokokita kandin no id pokilimus dangan, id po‑inturoy ran no mid ungketen to, “Konna vo ini me‑en no minuvu iddos od ounsad nod pokilimus?”
Kahi taddot duma to, “Oyya, sikandin en!” Piru duwon duma nid ikahi to, “Eh konna, nokod‑iling da ayu kos boyo ran.” Na sikandin don en kos mid ikahi to, “Siyak en idda.”
Purisu id inturan dan sikandin, kahi ran to, “Id monnu man nod pokokita kad?”

Mid tavak sikandin to, “Iddos minuvu no id ngoranan ki Disas, id bovaa sikandin to basak woy nopongnga, id daddas din idda ka‑ay't mata ku woy id po‑undiyon a nikandin to Linow't Siloe amoy od pondappug. De‑en id undiyon a woy id pondappug woy nokokita ad.”
Id inturan dan mandon sikandin, kahi ran to, “Na, ingkon don bo iddon minuvu?” Mid tavak sikandin to, “Tove‑en.”
Id Inturan to mgo Pariseo iddos Minuvun Butud Dangan
Na, id piyod dan diyot mgo Pariseo iddos minuvun butud dangan.
Oyya su Allow't Kod‑imolloy iddos kodbovaa ni Disas tat basak no id bawi rin taddot butud.
De‑en id inturan mandad sikandin to mgo Pariseo ko momonnu nod pokokita ron sikandin. Mid tavak sikandin to, “Id doddasan din to basak kos mata ku woy nopongnga, id pondappug a woy nokokita ad.”

Na, duwon dumon mgo Pariseo no mid ikahi to, “Iddos minuvu nid puung ka‑ay, konna pomon diyot Monama, oyya su id supak man sikandin to mgo suhu moka‑atag to Allow't Kod‑imolloy.” Piru iddos duma, mid ikahi to, “Otik mosaasaa iddon minuvu, dii nanoy sikandin od pokopuung to mokososoobbu no iling ka‑ay.” De‑en nokodba‑ad don sikandan.

Id intud mandon iddos mgo Pariseo taddot butud dangan, kahi ran to, “Su id bowiyan din man kos mata ru, ondan bo kos od ko‑oseng du moka‑atag kandin?” Kahi taddot minuvu to, “Atag koddi, sokkad sikandin no propeta.”
Piru iddos mgo ponguu to Judio, dii en od pomakoy no butud sikandin dangan woy ko-ungkay, od pokokita ron. De‑en id po‑umow ran iddos amoy woy inoy rin.
Na, id inturan sikandan taddot mgo ponguu, kahi ran to, “Anak dow ve‑en inin minuvu? Bonnaa vo no butud sikandin pomon poron to kodtobbow rin? Id monnu man nod pokokita ron sikandin?”
Mid tavak iddos amoy woy inoy rin to, “Oyya, anak doy en, woy bonnaa en no butud sikandin pomon poron to kodtobbow rin.
Piru ko id monnu nod pokokita ron sikandin woy ko ondoy kos id bawi to mata rin, ika en kos waa roy nosorolli. Intura row sikandin su duwon don man poddu rin.”

Idda en kos tavak taddot amoy woy inoy rin, oyyos novaakkan sikandan taddot mgo ponguu to Judio. Su iddos mgo ponguu, nokodsokkad no iddos ahad ondoy nod ikahi no si Disas en kos Mesiyas, dii ron od kilaannon no sakup diyot simba‑an to mgo Judio.
Na, idda en kos unayan no mid ikahi iddos amoy woy inoy rin to, “Intura row sikandin su duwon don man poddu rin.”

De‑en id po‑umow mandon taddot mgo ponguu to Judio iddos butud dangan woy id ikohiyan dan to, “Ponudtuu ru kos bonnaa, oyyos ka‑ay ki to isowwan to Monama. Su otik sikami, nosorollan doyd no iddos minuvu nid bawi kikow, mosaasaa.”
Kahi taddot minuvu to, “Waa a nokosaddoo ko mosaasaa vo sikandin o konna. Iyon ku ra nosorollan no siyak, butud dangan, piru ko‑ungkay, od pokokita ad!”
Na mid intud mandon sikandan to, “Ondan man kos id puungan din kikow? Id monnu rin man tid bawi kos mata ru?”
Id tavak sikandin to, “Id ponudtulan kud en sikiyu, piru diid kow mohod pominog. Mambot od ointud kow pa mandon? Ondan, id kopi‑i row mandad nod kovovallan no mgo tinodduwan din?”
Na, nolingasa ran woy id boliyungan dan sikandin tid ikahi to, “Te, sikkow en kos tinodduwan din, piru sikami, mgo tinodduwan koy ni Moises!
Nosorollan doy no mid ikahi dangan iddos Monama ki Moises, piru iddon minuvu, waa en moho saddoo roy ko ingkon sikandin id pomon.”
Kahi taddot minuvu to, “Od kosoobbuwan a moho koniyu! Sikandin kos nokovawi to mata ku, piru waa kow nokosaddoo ko ingkon sikandin id pomon.
Nosorollan ta no diid tavak kos Monama taddot dosalon to minuvun mosaasaa. Piru od tovakon din en iddos mopompomakoy woy'd puungan din iddos id kopi‑i rin.
Pomon poron to tigkonayan to ingod, waa ki pa nokorinog no duwon od pokovawi to minuvun butud pomon poron to kodtobbow rin.
De‑en otik waa pa sikandin id pomon diyot Monama, konna en nanoy sikandin od pokopuung to iling ka‑ay.”

Kahi taddot mgo ponguu to Judio to, “Pomon poron to kodtobbow ru, id dakkoo ka riyot saa woy ko‑ungkay, od pa‑awoy‑awoy ka mohod nonaw konami!” Idda ron en, id dorok dan sikandin pomon diyot simba‑an to mgo Judio.
Dos Diid Pomakoy ki Disas, od Poko‑iling to Butud

Na, norinog ni Disas iddos notomanan taddot butud dangan no id dorok pomon diyot simba‑an to mgo Judio. De‑en id nangkap sikandin ni Disas woy to nokita rin don, id inturan din, kahi rin to, “Id pomakoy ka vo taddot Anak to Minuvu?”
Mid tavak iddos minuvu to, “Sir, ponudtuli a ko ondoy sikandin amoy'd pomakoy a kandin.”
Kahin Disas to, “Nokita rud sikandin, oyyos sikandin don en inis id tongko kikow ko‑ungkay.”
Na idda ron en, mid lingko‑od iddos minuvu riyot isowwan ni Disas woy kahi rin to, “Longaggon, id pomakoy ad kikow.”

Kahin Disas to, “Iyon unayan no mid undini a to ampow't ingod amoy od hukum ko ondoy kos nokokilaa to Monama woy dos wora. Su iddos waa nokokilaa kandin, noko‑iling sikandan to mgo butud to kovonnaan woy od bowiyan ku sikandan amoy'd pokokita. Piru iddos od po‑uvag‑uvag no nokokilaa to Monama, id pokita ku no sikandan, mgo butud poron.”
Na, duwon mgo Pariseo riyot morani rin no nokorinog taddot id oseng din woy id inturan dan sikandin, kahi ran to, “Ondan? Iyon du vod osengon no ahad sikami, mgo butud mandad?”

Kahin Disas kandan to, “Otik id tanggap dow no noko‑iling kow to mgo butud to kovonnaan, worad nanoy saa row. Piru pomon tod osengon dow man no od pokokita kow su id po‑uvag‑uvag kow no duwon koovottan dow to kovonnaan, de‑en ponayun pe‑en iddos saa row.”
